variants.headline: Hunger is no licence for a blame game
variants.body: People in {colony} are hungry. There is not enough food. Whatever the argument, nobody can eat a speech. Give {target} a fair hearing.

variants.headline: Hold the easy verdict
variants.body: There is not enough food in {colony}, and people are hungry. A polished explanation is no substitute for something to eat. Give {target} a fair hearing.

variants.headline: Outrage alone cannot make the case
variants.body: Food is short in {colony}. People are hungry. The grandest vision of a new life still needs room for a meal. Give {target} a fair hearing.
